cycles.method: Conservative V4 core-path bounds from the native probe of the 0.2.2 source (evidence/probes.json, 3,170,412 cases, identical to 0.2.1's counts): one frame-hook pass per 16-sample block, at most 3,344 (SC_KEY variant, OTFX-T; 2,032 plain), plus the per-trig hooks for all eight tracks in the same block, 8 x (336 dispatch + 336 trig start + 352 fresh bind + 320 rebind + 304 trig flag) = 13,184. 382 is the largest measured MCF5206E model path. Budget: 264 MHz x 16 / 44,100 Hz. Not chip wall-clock timing.
